response.query: What delta ranges and tipping-point definitions are recommended for pattern-mixture MNAR sensitivity analyses in adherence with anticipated attrition up to 30%?
response.answer: Delta ranges up to 30% and tipping points typically at 10-20% are recommended for pattern-mixture MNAR sensitivity analyses. These values account for anticipated attrition.
